highlightImage.title: Mirror, Mirror on the Ball.
highlightImage.content:
The Kingdom has spoken, and the theme of this year's Elfia Ball has been revealed: Mirror, Mirror on the Ball.


On the evening of Saturday, 19 September, the magical halls of Giostra Fortunia will open for a night of dancing, enchantment, and storybook wonder. Whether you arrive as royalty, a daring hero, a mysterious villain, or a character all your own, the mirror awaits to reveal your tale.


The Ball begins at 20:30, but aspiring guests should take note: registration opens at 17:00 at the Information Booth. Only those 18 years old and above are accepted for entrance. Show your ID and claim your wristband. Access to the Ball is limited, and only the first 500 guests to register will receive entry, so be sure to secure your place early.


Throughout the evening, two exceptional guests will be chosen as the Diamonds of the Ball; the jewels of the kingdom and the fairest of them all. Elegance, creativity, and presence will shine brightly as the Kingdom's most enchanting attendees take to the dance floor.


Gather your finest attire, polish your crowns, and prepare for an unforgettable evening beneath the lights of Giostra Fortunia.


Will the mirror reflect a noble ruler, a legendary adventurer, a cunning rogue, or a dreamer from a distant realm? There is only one way to find out.


Mirror, mirror on the wall... who will be the fairest of them all?


Tickets for Elfia Arcen are available now via our Ticket - Elfia Arcen 2026


Credits: @slashleyphotography
highlightImage.description: Your heart begins to flutter.  Where the sun disappears, masks start to shimmer in the evening.  And inside the Giostra ballroom, 500 souls wait for the magic to begin.

highlightImage.title: Patty Gurdy
highlightImage.content:
Everyone remembers the moment their life changed. Patty's began with an instrument few people could even name.


When she first picked up the hurdy-gurdy after finishing school, she had no idea it would become such an important part of her story. What started as simple curiosity slowly unfolded into a passion that connected her with people across the world through music rooted in centuries of tradition.


Some stories don't begin with certainty. They begin with curiosity.
highlightImage.description: What if the instrument that changed your life was one you'd never even heard of?

highlightImage.title: The Trouble Notes
highlightImage.content:
Did you know The Trouble Notes only exist because one musician walked away from Wall Street?


Bennet traded a career in finance for a violin, a suitcase, and a dream of traveling the world through music. That single leap of faith became The Trouble Notes, a band that's now captivated audiences in more than 35 countries.


At Elfia, you'll experience the journey that started with one brave decision. Every melody carries a piece of the places they've explored, the people they've met, and the adventures they've lived.


Perhaps the greatest adventures do begin with just a single choice.
highlightImage.description: What happens when you choose passion over certainty?  The Trouble Notes are proof that one leap of faith can lead to extraordinary places.

highlightImage.title: Compagnia La Giostra
highlightImage.content:
For more than two decades, Compagnia La Giostra has travelled the world celebrating the spirit of medieval entertainers through music, storytelling, and theatrical performance. With authentic instruments, vibrant costumes, and infectious energy, they invite audiences to experience history not as something to observe, but something to be part of.


Saturday

Main Stage Performance

Gather before the Main Stage and let Compagnia La Giostra transport you to an age of wandering musicians, lively celebrations, and timeless melodies. Their signature blend of medieval music and theatrical storytelling brings centuries-old traditions to life with every note.


Sunday

Bard's Theatre Performance

The journey continues with a more intimate performance at Bard's Theatre. Whether through song, story, or shared laughter, Compagnia La Giostra reminds us that the oldest tales are often the ones that stay with us the longest.


Don't forget to grab your seat!
highlightImage.description: There was a time when stories weren't found in books, they were sung in bustling town squares, danced through village streets, and shared beneath the open sky.

highlightImage.title: Tribubu
highlightImage.content:
Did you know Tribubu means "It's because of you that I'm here"?


Inspired by the Spanish word Tribu (tribe) and the Bambara word Sababou, their name is more than a title, it's a celebration of the people who make every journey worthwhile.


Bringing together musicians from Spain, England, and Ivory Coast, Tribubu blends cultures, rhythms, and traditions into performances where every beat carries a story and every melody reminds us that music has always been a language shared by all.


Main Stage

Like the call of a wandering minstrel, Tribubu's melodies drift across the Kingdom, drawing adventurers from every corner to the Main Stage. With each rhythm, the paths of strangers cross, and for a moment, the entire Kingdom moves to the same heartbeat.


Bard's Theatre

When the echoes of the Main Stage begin to fade, the music continues elsewhere.


Follow the music to Bard's Theatre, where wandering bards, weary travellers, and kindred spirits gather beneath one roof. Around every melody, new friendships are forged, old legends are remembered, and every traveller finds a place among the tribe.


Every journey is richer when it's shared.
highlightImage.description: From the very first beat, Tribubu takes you on a musical journey across continents.

highlightImage.title: Merulsa
highlightImage.content:
Before Merulsa ever found an audience, she had two very patient parents.


At just two years old, she'd wake them in the middle of the night to sing the songs she'd learned at preschool. What began as childhood enthusiasm has grown into a voice that tells stories, stirs emotions, and creates moments of quiet wonder.


Blending folk-inspired melodies with heartfelt storytelling, Merulsa creates performances that invite audiences to pause, listen, and lose themselves in the music.


Sunday

Main Stage Performance

Experience Merulsa's enchanting music on the Main Stage, where every song carries a story and every melody adds another layer to the magic of the Kingdom.

Bard's Theatre

Join Merulsa at Bard's Theatre, where every melody feels like a story shared beside the hearth of an old tavern.

Bardeoke

Feeling inspired? Merulsa will also take part in the Bard's Theatre Bardeoke programme, celebrating music with fellow performers and festival guests in true Elfia fashion.


Some voices are simply meant to be heard.
highlightImage.description: Every song tells a story, and Merulsa has spent a lifetime learning how to tell them with heart.

highlightImage.title: Amsterdam Burlesque
highlightImage.content:
As twilight settles over the Kingdom of Elfia, whispers speak of a stage where every movement tells a story and every performance is woven with a touch of enchantment. There, the Amsterdam Burlesque Company welcomes curious souls into a realm of shimmering costumes, theatrical charm, and captivating artistry.


With graceful choreography, dazzling performances, and an irresistible sense of wonder, they blur the line between fantasy and reality. Inspired by the timeless allure of cabaret and the magic of the stage, each act is a celebration of confidence, creativity, and the joy of performance, inviting you to lose yourself in a world where elegance reigns and imagination knows no bounds.


The curtain rises this September.
highlightImage.description: Not everything that glitters is gold... sometimes it's feathers.

highlightImage.title: Fabius The Jester
highlightImage.content:
What if one performer could become an entire cast?


Fabius the Jester is a juggler, acrobat, comedian, clown, and fire performer all woven into one unforgettable show.


Every performance is filled with unexpected moments, playful humour, and astonishing skill, proving that sometimes one person is all it takes to captivate an entire crowd.


Expect the unexpected.


The best surprises are the ones you never see coming.
highlightImage.description: Some secrets are better left unexplained.

highlightImage.title: Leo Garbo
highlightImage.content:
The lights dim. The music begins.


For a moment, the Kingdom gives way to the glittering cabarets of 1920s Berlin, where glamour, mischief, and extraordinary artistry take centre stage.


With aerial performances, whip cracking, hula hoops, live music, and irresistible charm, Leo Garbo delivers a show unlike any other. Whether performing an adults-only cabaret or a family-friendly spectacle, every performance is filled with theatrical flair, humour, and unforgettable moments.


Saturday

Adults-Only Cabaret (18+)

As evening falls, Leo Garbo presents a bold cabaret inspired by the vibrant nightlife of 1920s Berlin. Expect dazzling performances, playful humour, and an unforgettable night created exclusively for adult audiences.


Sunday

Family-Friendly Show

On Sunday, the curtain rises for a performance the whole family can enjoy. Blending circus artistry, music, comedy, and theatrical storytelling, Leo Garbo invites audiences of all ages into a world where imagination takes centre stage.


Will you be there when the lights go down?
highlightImage.description: The lights dim. The music begins. For a moment, the Kingdom gives way to the glittering cabarets of 1920s Berlin.

highlightImage.title: Elfia Ball DJ
highlightImage.content:
Beyond the ballroom doors, a world of fantasy awaits.


With Claudia Tucci behind the decks, every song becomes an invitation to step onto the dance floor, celebrate with friends, and lose yourself in the magic of the evening.


Carefully weaving together fantasy favourites, and dancefloor anthems, she creates an atmosphere where every melody brings the ballroom to life.


Perhaps the night's greatest memory begins with a single step.
highlightImage.description: Unforgettable balls begin with one simple question..."Would you like to dance?"

highlightImage.title: Music Court
highlightImage.content:
Dance beneath the open sky and sing along with the Kingdom. The Music Court is where unforgettable performances, festival anthems, and magical moments come together. Gather with fellow Elfians and let the music carry you from the first note to the final encore.


Patty Gurdy

Step into Patty Gurdy’s tavern of melodies, where the unmistakable sound of the hurdy-gurdy meets catchy folk-pop, Celtic influences and a voice you won’t forget.


Żniwa

Two musicians, countless stories and a whole world of pagan folk. Żniwa blends Slavic, Celtic and Norse-inspired sounds with traditional melodies, historical music and their own original songs.


The Trouble Notes

Folk, rock and a whole lot of movement. The Trouble Notes turn violin, guitar and drums into cinematic storyscapes that can take you from a quiet tale to a full-on festival dance floor.


Compagnia La Giostra

Enter the world of medieval minstrels, Mediterranean rhythms and mischievous storytelling. With ancient instruments, lively songs and plenty of interaction, La Giostra turns every performance into a celebration.


Green Lads

Celtic music with the volume turned up! Green Lads fuse Irish-inspired melodies, fiddles, flute and traditional instruments with electronic beats and infectious rhythms; expect to dance.


Tribubu

Bring your dancing shoes! Tribubu mixes rumba, Afro-folk, blues and world music into an energetic, joyful sound filled with warm rhythms, powerful messages and melodies from around the globe.


Merulsa

Dreamy folk, enchanting vocals and stories told through music. Merulsa’s songs invite you to slow down, drift away into the melodies and, when the rhythm catches you, dance along.


Folkulaka

Ukrainian folklore takes a dark and wonderfully strange turn. Folkulaka reimagines traditional songs and dances as horror-folk, where haunting stories, eerie melodies and a wicked sense of humour meet.


Idun’s Apples

Stories from another age, carried by beautiful folk melodies. Idun’s Apples brings historically inspired ballads and soulful original songs to life, creating a sound that feels perfectly at home in a fantasy world.

highlightImage.title: Milites Flagwavers
highlightImage.content:
Did you know that some of the flag techniques performed today have been preserved for over 500 years?


What began as a skill for medieval standard bearers has become an art passed down through generations. Every throw, spin, and catch is rooted in traditions that once represented honour, pride, and the identity of entire cities.


At Elfia, Milites Flagwavers don't simply perform, they breathe new life into a legacy. Accompanied by the thunder of drums and a sea of vibrant banners, they'll transport you to an age where a single flag could unite a kingdom.


Perhaps some traditions are too extraordinary to be forgotten.
highlightImage.description: Long before words echoed across the battlefield, banners spoke for kingdoms. With every soaring flag, thunderous drumbeat, and perfectly timed flourish, Milites Flagwavers revive a centuries-old tradition that once inspired armies and united nations.

highlightImage.title: Akoestische Sfeermakers
highlightImage.content:
What started as a celebration of their own love story soon became a journey shared with thousands of others. Shortly after saying "I do," Sunny and Chris performed together at a wedding ceremony, unknowingly taking the first step towards what would become more than a decade of making music side by side.


Today, they're known as Akoestische Sfeermakers, bringing warmth, laughter, and unforgettable melodies wherever they go. As they wander through the Kingdom of Elfia, don't be surprised if a familiar tune draws you in, a chorus brings strangers together, or a simple moment becomes one you'll remember long after the festival ends.


Perhaps the most beautiful journeys begin with two people choosing to walk the same path.
highlightImage.description: All great duets have a beginning. This one started with "I do."

highlightImage.title: Teatro Pavana
highlightImage.content:
Look to the skies and you may spot the towering Giraffes.


Listen for curious footsteps and the playful Struzzis may already be nearby.


Throughout the weekend, Teatro Pavana's breathtaking creations roam the Kingdom of Elfia, turning every encounter into a moment of wonder. Stop, say hello, and capture the magic before these gentle giants disappear back into their fairytale.


The next chapter of your Elfia adventure might begin with a single giant footprint.
highlightImage.description: Keep your eyes on the horizon... the giants are coming.

highlightImage.title: Idun's Apple
highlightImage.content:
Some are hidden beneath ancient roots. Others linger in forgotten legends, waiting for someone curious enough to listen.


Drawing inspiration from Celtic and Scandinavian folklore, Idun's Apples weave original melodies that feel as though they've always belonged beneath the forest canopy.


Perhaps some secrets are only revealed through song.
highlightImage.description: Every forest holds echoes of another time.

highlightImage.title: Chelseaboy
highlightImage.content:
ChelseaBoy was never created simply to entertain.


What began as a journey of self-discovery evolved into a boundary-defying character where fantasy, identity, and imagination exist without limits. Today, every performance blends theatrical storytelling with otherworldly beauty, inviting audiences into a universe where creativity knows no rules.


After all, the greatest stories are the ones we dare to write ourselves.
highlightImage.description: Some of the most extraordinary characters begin as a search for yourself.

highlightImage.title: FlowMies
highlightImage.content:
It only took one festival.


One hoop.


One moment that quietly changed everything.


When Michelle Verhoeks discovered hoop flow in 2015, she found more than a new passion—she found a way to tell stories through movement. Since then, she has transformed dance, light, and fire into breathtaking performances that celebrate confidence, imagination, and the joy of self-expression.


Some paths find us before we ever think to look for them.


Giostra Fortunia

When the music begins and the first hoop takes flight, time seems to slow. Graceful movements become living poetry as hoops dance through the air, catching the light and drawing every gaze toward the centre of the square.


What began with a single festival has become a performance where movement, artistry, and wonder come together beneath the skies of the Kingdom.


Sometimes, all it takes is one moment to change your story.
highlightImage.description: One hoop. Countless stories.

highlightImage.title: Salem Dee
highlightImage.content:
To Remco Raessen, a puppet is never just an object, it's a character with a voice, a story, and a spark of life. Through heartfelt performances, he invites audiences to reconnect with their imagination and rediscover the wonder of make-believe.


A little imagination can bring anything to life.
highlightImage.description: For Remco, Every Puppet Has a Soul

highlightImage.title: Bard’s D20 Adventures
highlightImage.content:
Bard’s D20 Adventures is a live interactive fantasy show where visitors step on stage as heroes and help create improvised adventures guided by a Game Master. Audience participation and the roll of a giant D20 determine the course of the story.


Each adventure comes alive with live music from The Trouble Notes, reacting to the unfolding story.
highlightImage.description: Roll the giant D20, shape the adventure, and become the hero of an improvised fantasy quest brought to life with live music.

highlightImage.title: Elfia Academy
highlightImage.content:
Dragon Egg Design Workshop


The Kingdom of Elfia invites its Citizens to learn the ancient craft of Dragon Egg Design under the guidance of Guild Master Darja Blinova, illustrator and artist of the Kingdom.


Every dragon's story begins with an egg.


Within the halls of the Elfia Academy, Guild Master Darja Blinova will guide Citizens through the art of designing their very own dragon egg. Inspired by the rich lore of the Kingdom, this creative workshop is an opportunity to explore colour, symbolism and imagination while bringing a unique dragon egg to life.


Whether you are a young adventurer, an experienced artist or simply curious to discover one of the Kingdom's ancient crafts, this class offers a relaxing moment to sit, create and become part of Elfia's living story.


Guild Master: Darja Blinova – Illustrator & Artist

highlightImage.title: Costume Catwalk
highlightImage.content:
Beyond every cloak, every handcrafted piece of armour, every pair of enchanted wings, and every carefully stitched detail lies a story waiting to be told. The Costume Catwalk is your invitation to step into the spotlight and share that story with fellow dreamers.


Whether you have travelled from an ancient elven forest, emerged from the depths of a forgotten kingdom, or created a world entirely your own, this stage belongs to every fantasy enthusiast. Walk the Catwalk, strike a pose, and let the Kingdom of Elfia celebrate the creativity and passion behind your costume.


This is not a competition, there are no judges, no prizes, and no winners. Just a stage filled with extraordinary characters and a community that appreciates the artistry, dedication, and imagination behind every creation.


The Costume Catwalk takes place on Sunday at 3:00 PM at Giostra Fortunia.

Adventurers wishing to participate can register at the Information Booth during one of the following registration periods:


•⁠ ⁠Saturday: 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM

•⁠ ⁠Sunday : 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM


Upon registration, participants will receive a wristband granting access to the Costume Catwalk.


There are only 30 places available.

highlightImage.title: Folkulaka
highlightImage.content:
Before these tales reached the stage, they were shared around family tables, whispered by grandparents, and carried from one generation to the next. They are the stories Folkulaka grew up with; the witches who outwitted kings, the spirits who watched over rivers, and the mysterious creatures that have lingered in Ukrainian folklore for centuries.


At Elfia, Folkulaka opens the door to that world. Through haunting melodies, traditional instruments, and heartfelt storytelling.


Step into their world, and let the music tell the rest.

highlightImage.title: Lisa Chudalla
highlightImage.content:
Rumour has it that somewhere within the Kingdom of Elfia wanders an artist who never quite chose between the circus, the sideshow, and the world of dreams. Instead, Lisa Chudalla embraced them all, crafting performances where beauty and unease dance hand in hand.


With breathtaking aerial acrobatics, daring sword swallowing, and striking visuals that blur the line between fantasy and reality, she invites you into a world where curiosity is rewarded and the impossible feels strangely within reach.


Some wonders are as unsettling as they are unforgettable.
highlightImage.description: Whispers tell of a woman who fears no blade. With every sword she swallows, the Mistress of Steel blurs the line between myth and reality.

highlightImage.title: Trine
highlightImage.content:
From gleaming suits of armour to enchanted relics and mythical creatures, Trine has spent years breathing life into worlds once confined to imagination. Her remarkable craftsmanship has caught the attention of legendary realms beyond Elfia, leading her to create spectacular cosplays and props for studios such as Bethesda, Bandai Namco, Rebel Wolves, and HoYoverse.


Now, her journey leads to the Kingdom of Elfia, where she will take her place among the Costume Parade Judges. With every stitch, every sculpted detail, and every carefully crafted piece, she'll be searching for the stories waiting to be discovered.


The next tale to enchant her has yet to be written.
highlightImage.description: Craft the extraordinary and make fantasy tangible. Championing the makers behind this year's finest creations...

highlightImage.title: GiulioMugs
highlightImage.content:
Through extraordinary makeup artistry and breathtaking transformations, Giulio has turned countless faces into unforgettable heroes, villains, and mythical beings, reminding us that imagination knows no limits.


Now, Giulio joins the Kingdom of Elfia as one of this year's Costume Parade Judges. With every transformation, they'll be searching for the creativity, craftsmanship, and spirit that breathe life into every character.


The next tale to capture his eye is yet to be written.
highlightImage.description: Disguise yourself and make every glance count. Helping choose this year's most unforgettable transformations...

highlightImage.title: LevyLike
highlightImage.content:
For more than 13 years, Levy has done just that. Through countless hours of crafting, performing, and competing, she has represented the Netherlands on international cosplay stages including the European Cosplay Gathering (ECG), World Cosplay Summit (WCS), PGEC, and the Netherlands Cosplay Championship (NCC).


Now, her journey brings her to the Kingdom of Elfia, where she joins this year's Costume Parade Judges. Inspired by the community that shaped her own adventure, she'll be looking for costumes that celebrate creativity, craftsmanship, and the stories woven into every stitch.


Inspired by the community that shaped her own adventure, she'll be searching for the costumes that breathe life into unforgettable characters.

highlightImage.content:
Join acclaimed makeup artist GiulioMugs as he reveals how makeup can shape not only a character's appearance, but the story they can tell before a single word is spoken.


Discover how facial proportions, expression, and colour influence the way we perceive a character. What gives a face an air of innocence? What makes it appear cruel, mysterious, or wise? Through practical techniques and creative insight, discover how every brushstroke becomes another chapter in a character's story.


Whether you're crafting a fearless hero, a cunning villain, or an entirely original creation, this workshop will help you bring greater depth, personality, and storytelling to every character you create.

highlightImage.title: Wheel Sensation
highlightImage.content:
For over two decades, Laura and Boy have dedicated themselves to mastering the art of movement. World Champions in the German Wheel and internationally celebrated performers, they have transformed elite athleticism into breathtaking theatrical spectacle.


As Wheel Sensation, they combine the elegance of the German Wheel and Cyr Wheel with aerial acrobatics, hand balancing, pole artistry, and more, creating performances where strength, grace, and imagination become one.


For a few unforgettable moments, gravity loosens its grip and wonder takes its place.

highlightImage.title: Celtic Constellation
highlightImage.content:
Born from an Irish jam session and fuelled by a shared passion for folk traditions, Celtic Constellation weaves together the musical colours of Europe into one unforgettable experience. From lively Celtic jigs and Swedish polskas to Breton grooves, African rhythms, and original compositions, every performance is a journey across cultures.


With Laura's soaring fiddle, Lars' irresistible percussion, and Boet's rich accordion and bouzouki melodies, the trio creates a sound that is both deeply rooted in tradition and refreshingly their own. Their music shifts effortlessly between spirited dances, heartfelt ballads, and melodies that stir the imagination.


Whether you find yourself clapping along, swaying to the rhythm, or unable to resist joining the dance, from the first note to the final encore, their music fills the air with adventure, celebration, and wonder.
highlightImage.description: From One Jam Session to Countless Dance Floors.

highlightImage.title: Airboxes
highlightImage.content:
For more than a decade, Bert Leemans and Guus Herremans have shared a remarkable partnership. Together, they have performed on renowned stages across Europe, captivating audiences with a sound that is both deeply rooted in tradition and boldly innovative.


As Airboxes, the duo explores the limitless possibilities of acoustic music, blending chromatic and diatonic accordions with rich harmonies and original compositions. Their evolving repertoire draws inspiration from folk traditions across the continent, creating timelessness and originality.


Join them on an unforgettable listening experience at Elfia!

highlightImage.title: Bard's Theater
highlightImage.content: From whispered ballads to thunderous applause, Bard's Theater is where gifted performers weave music, stories, and magic into unforgettable moments.

highlightImage.title: Lights. Camera. Confidence – Amsterdam Burlesque
highlightImage.content:
Ever wondered how some cosplayers seem to come alive the moment a camera points their way? Join the talented performers of Amsterdam Burlesque and discover how to pose with confidence, embody your character, and feel completely at ease in front of the lens.


Through a playful combination of dance, theatre, and embodiment exercises, you'll learn how to use your posture, movement, and facial expressions to create dynamic, in-character poses. Whether you're portraying a fierce warrior, an elegant fae, or a mischievous rogue, this workshop will help you communicate your character before saying a single word.


Expect a high-energy session filled with movement, collaboration, and plenty of laughter as you build confidence and unleash your inner performer. No previous dance or performance experience is needed, just bring your imagination and a willingness to step into the spotlight.


Please bring:

  1. A short description of your character to work from
  2. Your phone

highlightImage.title: The Secrets Behind Armour Making - Trine
highlightImage.content:
Not all legendary armour is forged in fire.


Within the halls of the Elfia Academy, Guild Master Trine will guide aspiring makers through the craft of cosplay armour, sharing techniques for selecting materials, creating custom patterns, painting, detailing, and achieving a professional finish. Whether you're building your very first set or perfecting your latest creation, this workshop will help turn imagination into armour worthy of any realm.


Guild Master: Trine


Sunday

12:00 PM - 12:45 PM


Click to Register!
highlightImage.description: Discover how materials, patterning, painting, and finishing techniques come together to transform simple foam into armour worthy of any hero.

highlightImage.title: The Art of Living Sculptures - Evelien
highlightImage.content:
How do you transform a human body into convincing bronze or carved stone?


During this lecture at Elfia, discover the makeup techniques behind the illusion of a living statue. Learn how colour, shading, texture, and highlights can transform skin into patinated bronze or weathered stone.


But becoming a living statue is about more than makeup. You’ll also discover the basic performance techniques that bring a statue to life — from standing and holding poses to moving and interacting with an audience while maintaining the illusion.


There will also be plenty of time to ask questions, so bring your curiosity!


Perfect for cosplayers, performers, and fantasy lovers who want to bring statue characters to life, this lecture offers a fascinating look behind the art of Living Sculptures.


Step into the illusion and discover what it takes to become the artwork.


Guild Master: Evelien Beuman


Saturday

12:15PM - 1:00PM


Click to Register!
highlightImage.description: Can a person really look like carved stone? Discover the techniques behind the illusion and learn how to bring a living statue to life.

highlightImage.title: Żniwa
highlightImage.content:
Quite a lot, probably but Żniwa makes it sound magical. This married duo of multi-instrumentalists brings an unusual mix of Slavic, Nordic and neo-Celtic folk music to Elfia Arcen, switching between an impressive collection of traditional and historical instruments.


From the haunting sound of the tagelharpa to Celtic harp, five-string violin, bowed lute and, yes, even a didgeridoo, Żniwa creates music that feels like it wandered straight out of an ancient folk tale.


Come hear this wonderfully strange musical adventure for yourself.
highlightImage.description: A Celtic harp. A Viking fiddle. A didgeridoo. What could possibly go wrong?

highlightImage.title: The Royal Seahorseriders
highlightImage.content:
The Royal Seahorseriders invite you into their extraordinary steampunk encampment, where the boundaries between fantasy, invention and time begin to blur.


Their journeys have taken them through strange worlds and distant times, and they’ve returned with curious objects, remarkable stories and machines unlike anything you’ve seen before. Meet the Enigma, the Seahorse and the Serena, each with its own story to tell, and watch these fantastical vehicles come to life.


Listen to tales of their travels through time, explore the treasures they’ve collected along the way, and let your imagination wander into a world where impossible machines might just be possible.


Step into their encampment and see where their next adventure takes you.
highlightImage.description: They travelled through time and they brought souvenirs.

highlightImage.title: Green Lads
highlightImage.content:
Born from a love of lively folk music and the joy of bringing people together, this five-piece combines two fiddles, flute, guitar and tap dancing into one wildly energetic performance.


From intimate village squares to major French stages, they’ve turned their passion for Celtic music into a show that’s impossible to stand still to.


So when you hear the fiddles start… you know it’s time to dance.


Meet the Green Lads at Elfia!
highlightImage.description: Fiddles, flutes, electro beats… and tap dancing?!

highlightImage.title: Healing Sounds
highlightImage.content:
What if you made time for yourself part of your Elfia adventure?


Step into the Healing Garden of Eden, a space made for slowing down, connecting and enjoying the moment. From healing sounds and meditation to other relaxing experiences, the garden invites you to pause the adventure and simply breathe.


Bring a friend, meet fellow Elfians or take a moment just for yourself.
highlightImage.description: Need to recharge your magical energy? There’s a garden waiting for you.

highlightImage.title: Electrad
highlightImage.content:
At the heart of Electrad are Vincent Garcia and Riwall Harjay, two musicians who share a love for Breton music but come from different musical worlds.


Vincent has spent years playing and teaching diatonic accordion, while Riwall found his way into electronic music and DJing. When they joined forces, they started experimenting with what happens when traditional Breton melodies meet machines, beats and electronic textures.


The result is Electrad; a fresh, energetic take on Fest-Noz music that’s made to be felt and danced to.
highlightImage.description: Ever wondered what Breton folklore would sound like at midnight?

highlightImage.title: Perry Mulder
highlightImage.content:
Perry Mulder returns to Giostra Fortunia, ready to guide Elfians through another enchanting weekend of music, merriment, and magical moments. Step into the tent, join the festivities, and let Perry be your guide as the tales of Elfia Arcen unfold.


Join the revelry at Giostra Fortunia.
highlightImage.description: Perry Mulder returns to Giostra Fortunia!

highlightImage.title: Balforia
highlightImage.content:
Follow the sound of Balforia and you’ll find yourself somewhere between a Scandinavian folk tale and a lively village dance.


Led by Martin Seeberg of Trolska Polska, Balforia blends Balfolk traditions with Scandinavian melodies, creating flowing, trance-like music that invites everyone to move together.


From Andros and Scottish dances to Bourrées and polskas, the Bal-fairies turn the dance floor into their own little fairytale; all you have to do is join in.


Let the Bal-fairies lead the way.
highlightImage.description: The Bal-fairies are calling...

highlightImage.title: Captain Ratcatchers
highlightImage.content:
The legendary treasure of Port Arctigua has vanished, and Captain Ratcatcher needs brave adventurers to help the Rattenbande find it!


Gather your crew and head to Blackskull Bay, where pirates, duels and daring challenges await. Sharpen your skills, prove your worth and fight your way through the adventure but beware, the treasure won’t give itself up without a fight!


Do you have what it takes to join the Rattenbande?
highlightImage.description: Ahoy! The hunt for Port Arctigua’s treasure begins!

highlightImage.title: Forever in Bloom-Bee Taxidermy - Fenna's Atelier
highlightImage.content:
There’s a whole world hidden in the smallest details.


This workshop combines insect taxidermy, natural materials and art to create miniature scenes inspired by nature. The artist also works with hand-painted watercolour backgrounds, bringing preserved insects back to life in imaginative natural environments.


Create your own glass cloche with a bee or Asian/European hornet and learn more about the fascinating world of insects.


€2 materials fee — includes a small glass cloche, bee or hornet, glue and natural decoration.


Guild Master: Fenna

1:30PM - 2:30PM

highlightImage.description: What if you could capture a little piece of the wild? Explore the fascinating art of preserving insects and creating miniature worlds where nature lives on.

highlightImage.title: Duo Sionneau - Gielen
highlightImage.content:
It all starts with two musicians and a love for the sounds of another time. With hurdy-gurdy and diatonic accordion in hand, Duo Sionneau-Gielen take you on a musical journey through lively folk melodies, where old traditions meet their own playful and spirited notes.


Don’t miss the chance to lose yourself in the music.
highlightImage.description: Let the old world play.

highlightImage.title: Scoring Emotions: Behind the Elfia Score - Steven Stoffels
highlightImage.content:
Go behind the scenes of the music that accompanies the world of Drach-oc.


Steven will share his creative process, exploring how a musical score is shaped around characters, moments and atmosphere. A glimpse into the sounds, ideas and emotions that help turn the story on the page into something you can hear.

highlightImage.content:
Every story has a beginning. This is where the world of Elfia takes its first steps.


Join the creator and writer of Drach-oc for a special look at its prologue, bringing the opening chapter of this magical world to the screen. Hear the story directly from the people who created it and get a glimpse into how Drach-oc came to life.

highlightImage.title: Balfolk
highlightImage.content:
Balfolk is a joyful mix of Western European folk dances, music and a whole lot of fun. Never danced before? No problem. You’ll learn the basics, follow the music and get swept up in the rhythm and if you arrive without a dance partner, you’ll find plenty of fellow adventurers ready to join you on the dance floor.


Before the Balfolk band takes the stage, they will lead a lively workshop where you’ll learn the basics, including the magic circle and the gigue. Orcs, pirates, wizards, pixies, stormtroopers and plainclothes elves are all welcome.


So leave your inhibitions behind, join the circle and dance your way into the adventure.
highlightImage.description: Put down the sword and pick up a dance partner.

highlightImage.title: Cosplay Repair
highlightImage.content:
Your carefully crafted cosplay is looking chef’s kiss… until suddenly something comes loose, breaks or decides to reveal a little more than you had planned.


Don’t panic! Instead of spending the rest of Elfia clutching your costume together with one hand, head over to the Cosplay Repair team.


Our friendly and talented repair crew is ready to help get your costume back in shape, so you can get both hands back and enjoy everything Elfia has to offer. And this time, they’re joined by two artists specialising in grimas and make-up, ready to add a little colour, touch up your look or give your character a freshen-up.


Nothing broken? No problem! Come by for a chat, say hello and soak up the cosy atmosphere. After all, cosplay is all about having fun, being creative and enjoying Elfia together.


So if your costume cries for help, you know where to go!
highlightImage.description: Your costume has betrayed you and they're here to save the day.

highlightImage.title: De Lekke Ton
highlightImage.content:
Ahoy, landlubbers!


The crew of De Lekke Ton has sailed into Elfia, and they’re bringing pirates, mermaids and plenty of mischief with them. Their ship will be roaming the festival grounds, searching for treasure, adventure and unsuspecting landlubbers to encounter along the way.


So keep one eye on the horizon and your valuables firmly in your pocket. When you see the ship approaching, you’ll know the pirates have come ashore…


Whether you join their adventure or simply cross their path, one thing is certain: Elfia is about to get a little more piratey.
highlightImage.description: There’s a pirate ship on the loose…

highlightImage.title: Blackshield
highlightImage.content:
The campfire is burning, the shields are ready and the Vikings of Blackshield Forge have arrived at Elfia.


Discover a world of warriors, craftsmanship and ancient traditions, with plenty to see, hear and explore around the camp.


Come meet the people behind the shields, admire their craftsmanship and soak up the atmosphere of a Viking camp brought to life.
highlightImage.description: Hear that? The Vikings are calling...

highlightImage.title: Erik The Viking
highlightImage.content:
Prepare for a fiery adventure with Erik the Viking!


Watch Erik the Viking bring together daring fire tricks, outrageous comedy, and plenty of Viking spirit for a spectacular show that will have you laughing, gasping, and cheering for more.


From jaw-dropping flames to hilarious moments, Erik knows how to turn up the heat and keep the whole family entertained.


A fiery spectacle for young and old; and one you definitely don’t want to miss!
highlightImage.description: Ready for a little fire, laughter, and Viking madness?

highlightImage.title: Furries Embassy
highlightImage.content:
Hail, Elfians!


The Furry Embassy once again opens its doors to curious travellers. Step inside to meet colourful, fluffy creatures and discover more about the Furry Fandom, its costumes, events, and communities.


Feeling warm after wandering the realm? A Refreshment Station is available for Elfians in heavy costumes to cool down. And before you depart, don’t forget to collect your Furry Embassy passport stamp!
highlightImage.description: Fluffy creatures, curious costumes, and a very special passport stamp await!

highlightImage.title: Pirate Embassy
highlightImage.content:
Ahoy, Elfians!


The Pirate Embassy welcomes brave adventurers, curious travellers, and fellow scallywags! Step aboard and discover the world of pirates, their stories, traditions, and seafaring adventures.


And before you set sail once more, be sure to visit the Embassy and collect your special Pirate Embassy passport stamp!
highlightImage.description: Your passport is missing a pirate’s mark…

highlightImage.title: Mirror, Mirror: Magic in a Bottle - Happy Hatchlings
highlightImage.content:
The enchanted mirrors of the Royal Ballroom hold more than just reflections… and now, you have the chance to capture their magic.


Join Happy Hatchlings and create your very own Mirror, Mirror Elixir, infused with the shimmering essence of the enchanted mirrors found within the Royal Ballroom.


Mix, swirl and watch your potion come to life as you create a magical elixir filled with iridescent colour and shimmering mica. Then seal your creation, decorate its bottle and give it an enchanted label, ready to take home as a little piece of the Ball.


But remember… every mirror keeps a secret. What will yours reveal?


Workshop fee: €3.40 per participant.

highlightImage.description: The Ball has its secrets… and some of them belong in a bottle. Join Happy Hatchlings for a magical crafting adventure inspired by Mirror, Mirror on the Ball. Create and decorate your very own elixir bottle, filled with a little mystery, a little magic, and plenty of imagination.

highlightImage.title: Folk Faire
highlightImage.content:
TriOblique

Feel the energy of TriOblique! Formed in Genoa, this dynamic trio blends Irish and Breton traditional music with unexpected twists of rock, funk, and soft melodies. Their debut album, Danse avec les renards, has already made crowds across Europe dance with joy. Curious? Come see them live and try not to dance.


Le Driadi

Step into the magical sound of Le Driadi. Blending neo-trad balfolk, Italian songwriting, and indie vibes, their music feels both ancient and fresh. From dreamy mazurkas to high-energy scottishes and lively Breton chains, their performances turn into real dance journeys. Born from late-night jam sessions across Europe, they bring warm energy, infectious rhythm, and a magical atmosphere that pulls you in, one note, and you will not want to leave the dance floor.


Viadeyra

Step into a journey through time with Viadeyra. From ancient Latin rhythms to Sephardic melodies, their music blends sounds from across Europe into one magical dance experience. Formed by musicians from groups like Le Driadi, they bring centuries-old traditions back to life with a fresh balfolk twist. Expect spinning dances, rich history, and a sound that carries you across cultures.


Hai la Joc

Discover the vibrant energy of Hai la Joc. A lively dance group from Groningen, they bring cultures to life through traditional dances from countries like Argentina, Mexico, South Africa, Georgia, and Turkey, plus their own Dutch dances they proudly share at festivals abroad.


Paloina

Experience the magic of Paloina. With around 25 talented dancers and a powerful live orchestra, this international ensemble brings folklore to life through authentic costumes, vibrant rhythms, and rich cultural traditions. Their performances are more than just a show, they are a journey across cultures.


Dansensemble Phoenix

Welcome back Dansensemble Phoenix. For the third year in a row, this young and passionate folk dance group returns to Elfia full of energy and joy. They bring traditional dances from cultures around the world, all performed to authentic music that fills the air with vibrant rhythm. This year, they present a brand new repertoire featuring dances from Greece, Mallorca, Italy, Georgia, and Albania. With lively steps and contagious enthusiasm, Phoenix shows how folklore can beautifully connect people across borders.
highlightImage.description: A joyful realm of folk dance and live world traditions, where rhythm, culture, and movement connect everyone.

highlightImage.title: Bandits Creek
highlightImage.content:
Akoestische Sfeermakers

A sun-blond wandering songbird and acoustic guitarist bring raw western energy to every corner of Elfia (Bandits Creek). Keep an eye out for our old outlaw cargo bike, as you will often hear us long before you see us. We deliver authentic, roaming live performances that feel like a sudden desert showdown, made for travelers, outlaws, and wandering souls. Tune in and you never know where we will appear next.

Ride into Bandits Creek with De Akoestische Sfeermakers Acoustic Flavour.
highlightImage.description: A rugged western pocket of roaming acoustic outlaws, dusty charm, and spontaneous live music.

highlightImage.title: Music Court
highlightImage.content:
The Trouble Notes

Enter a world of sound with The Trouble Notes This wandering trio of musical storytellers creates epic, wordless journeys through soaring violin, rhythmic guitar, and tribal percussion. Blending world-folk traditions with cinematic intensity, their music feels both ancient and otherworldly. At Elfia, expect a powerful mix of energy and enchantment, where every note brings fantasy to life and invites you to feel, imagine, and move.


Deloraine

Prepare for an unforgettable spectacle with Deloraine This nine-member band delivers an epic performance filled with dancers, pagan rituals, and powerful fantasy music. Expect driving rhythms, stunning costumes, and breathtaking fire performances that turn the stage into a world of pure magic and energy.


Sowulo

Meet Sowulo a Dutch Nordic folk project that feels like an ancient ritual brought to life. Powerful rhythms, old instruments, and myth-inspired songs in ancient languages create a deep, magical atmosphere. It is not just music,it feels like a journey through nature, spirit, and time. If you love something mystical and unforgettable, this is a must-see.


Sunfire

Meet Sunfire a high energy band from The Hague bringing their own explosive style of Western Folk to life. Mixing Americana, folk, country, bluegrass, roots, and rock, they turn every stage into a wild ride through the Old West.Dressed in 19th century western style and packed with powerful musicianship, Sunfire delivers dramatic stories, strong rhythms, and a touch of humour that gets every crowd moving. Hold onto your hat, this is one ride you do not want to miss.


Compagnia La Giostra

Meet La Giostra an Italian medieval folk band that blends old melodies, Latin songs, and traditional folk with modern sounds.With bagpipes, flutes, percussion, and looping rhythms, they create a lively mix of Celtic, Mediterranean, and tarantella styles.It feels like stepping into a medieval festival made for dancing and energy.


3 Daft Monkeys

Meet 3 Daft Monkeys from the coast of Cornwall, bringing wild folk energy with a global twist.Their music mixes Cornish roots with Balkan and Romani influences, powerful fiddle lines, and upbeat rhythms that instantly pull you in. Full of playful storytelling, punk spirit, and pure dance energy, every show feels like a celebration.At Elfia, expect a joyful, high energy journey that will make you dance, smile, and leave completely lifted.


Good Habits

Meet Good Habits a vibrant indie folk trio turning big emotions into joyful, high energy music.Fronted by cellist Bonnie Schwarz with accordion, synths, and drums, they blend folk storytelling with cinematic sound and groove driven rhythms. Born from a spontaneous journey in New Zealand, their music is all about connection, resilience, and pure creative joy.From major festivals like Glastonbury to intimate stages, they bring playful energy and uplifting moments that make every room come alive.


Daridel

Meet Daridel a band that sounds like it walked straight out of an ancient ritual and into a modern festival.Expect pounding drums, wild flutes, haunting bagpipes, and melodies that feel like forests, fire, and forgotten legends coming alive. Their music pulls you into a world of Celtic and pagan energy where standing still is not an option.


It is not just a concert... it feels like stepping into a tribal celebration you did not know you needed.


Reikas Tanz

Meet Reikas Tanz a female fronted folk band known for uplifting, danceable music across Europe's biggest festivals.They mix emotional songs of longing and freedom with powerful rhythms and modern folk energy. Using instruments like hurdy gurdy, nyckelharpa, accordion, and bouzouki, they create a magical sound that pulls you straight into the dance.


Merulsa

Meet Merulsa a folk singer-songwriter with a warm, captivating voice and expressive guitar playing.She tells honest stories from her own life and the world around her, turning them into intimate, emotional songs that connect easily with the audience. On bigger stages, she is joined by her band with Tycho on bass, Hans on drums, and Jan on piano, creating a fuller and richer live sound.A flute player, Femke, may also join in the near future, adding even more colour to her growing musical journey.


The Lonesome Malones

Meet The Lonesome Malones a fresh bluegrass band from the Netherlands bringing pure American roots energy to the stage.Born from festival jam sessions, they mix tight harmonies, fast picking, and traditional country bluegrass with real heart and energy. Their sound feels like campfires, open roads, and endless summer nights.


It is lively, authentic, and made to get you moving from the very first note.


Perkelt

Meet PerKelt a high energy pagan speed folk band that feels like a ritual set on fire.They blend Celtic melodies, breakneck bluegrass, and math rock precision into wild, unstoppable rhythms. Led by guitarist and producer Stepan Honc, the band brings together global influences and powerful musical storytelling.With soaring fiddle, dazzling recorder lines, shamanic vocals, and explosive drums, PerKelt creates a fast, hypnotic, and electrifying live experience that feels both ancient and futuristic.


Luneris

Meet Luneris two sisters blending techno and psytrance with Celtic and Nordic traditional sounds.Their music feels like an ancient ritual reborn in the future, where electric harp and violin merge with powerful electronic beats. The result is an immersive live experience that pulls the audience into a collective trance.It is energetic, hypnotic, and made for dancing, vibrating, and completely losing yourself in the moment.
highlightImage.description: The beating heart of Vorden where bands, fantasy sounds, and dance energy come alive all day.

highlightImage.title: Odin's Vale
highlightImage.content:
Enter the Viking realm, where the guidance of Odin inspires travelers through ancient sagas and legendary tales. The sound of pounding drums and the voices of skalds fill the air, carrying stories of the past. The presence of Valhalla is felt all around, inviting every soul to connect with the North and take part in the adventure.


The Blackshield began as the Blackshield Forge and has grown into a full Viking brotherhood of warriors, craftsmen, and storytellers united by honour and history. With over twenty years of experience and more than 250 performances, they once again brought the Viking world vividly to life at Elfia.


Visitors who entered their encampment witnessed intense combat, sword duels, and the skilled craftsmanship of true Viking artisans.
highlightImage.description: A Viking realm of sagas, drums, skaldic spirit, and warriors carrying the call of Valhalla.

highlightImage.title: Deus Ex Machina
highlightImage.content:
Step into our Steampunk Zone, and discover rare artifacts, handmade creations, and imaginative inventions that combine elements of fantasy and machinery. This is where the sound of steam and moving gears creates immersive atmosphere It is a place to explore and experience the excitement of a steam-powered adventure.


The Kloek-Dapper

An interactive street theatre experience, or more precisely, a bold mobile installation that transforms into a performance only when the audience dares to take part.It returns to the essentials as true installation theatre. Nothing is concealed and nothing feels overly decorative. The structures are solid and the mechanics are simple, clear, and easy to understand, highlighting the timeless beauty of simplicity.

Made from pure steel and wood, it combines natural and human energy. With strong hands both big and small pulling thick ropes, rhythm instruments come alive and marionettes take flight, moving freely like birds.This is a powerful yet delicate collaboration between humans and machines, creating poetic moments full of strength, movement, and imagination.


Der Sternenwächter

Is your soul ready for the Soul Slinger?

Our court scientist Micha-elo Da Vinci created the Seelenschleuderer, a module that simulates a kind of weightlessness. Inside it, you can rotate freely in all directions through 360 degrees, experiencing the sensation of being completely released from gravity.


Once you enter the device, your feet are secured to the Soul Slinger, and by shifting your body weight you can control both the direction and speed of the spin yourself.


However, a warning must be given. During one test, the soul of a young man was reportedly thrown out of his body, leaving behind an unfortunate zombie-like shell. As shown in the image, Micha-elo did everything possible to prevent the soul from escaping, but the forces of the 11th dimension appeared too strong, likely due to the extremely low weight of the young man's soul.


Royal Seahorserides

Made a return to Elfia, once again presenting a stunning steampunk fantasy world that brought together creative minds from across the Netherlands. Visitors entered their impressive camp and immersed themselves in stories, inventions, moving machines, and remarkable steampunk creations. Many guests also stamped their time traveller passports at the Amt für Aetherangelegenheiten, known as the Office for Aether Affairs, before unwinding under the large canopy or spending time with young adventurers through colouring activities and games like the well-known seahorse lace.
highlightImage.description: A steampunk zone of gears, invention, and theatrical mechanical wonders powered by imagination.

highlightImage.content: Discover Fable Forge, Elfia's centre for creativity and learning. You can join a variety of workshops such as costume design, illustration, performance arts, and unique crafts, or attend engaging talks that inspire new ideas. It is the perfect place to develop your skills, explore your creativity, and express yourself freely
highlightImage.description: Elfia's creative workshop district for learning, making, and exploring performance, cosplay, and craft.

subContentHighlight.title: Living Statues
subContentHighlight.content:
How do you transform a human body into convincing bronze or carved stone?


During this lecture at Elfia, I will demonstrate the makeup techniques used to create the illusion of living statues. Discover how colors, shading, texture, and highlights can turn skin into patinated bronze or weathered stone.


But creating a living statue is more than just makeup. I will also share the basic performance techniques that help bring a statue to life, how to stand, move, hold poses, and interact with an audience while maintaining the illusion.


There will also be plenty of room to ask questions, so feel free to bring your curiosity!


Perfect for cosplayers, performers, and fantasy lovers who want to bring statue characters to life. Step in and discover the secrets behind the art of Living Sculptures.

subContentHighlight.title: The Frounds Family
subContentHighlight.content:
The Frouds are a creative team working together as a family, turning imagination into living fantasy worlds. Their work focuses on designing, interpreting, and building characters, with collaborations spanning from Labyrinth through The Dark Crystal to The Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance. Together, they blend storytelling, art, and craftsmanship into immersive and magical creations.


Wendy, Brian, and Toby Froud also explore different creative processes, from painting, sculpting, and writing to transforming 2D designs into detailed 3D figures and puppets. Through teaching and creating side by side, they continue to build rich, imaginative worlds that bring fantasy to life.


Toby Froud reference article: Enchanted Living

subContentHighlight.title: Nature Deco
subContentHighlight.content:
Nature Deco offers unique, hands-on workshops where participants learn the delicate art of taxidermy in a guided and respectful way. Under the supervision of experienced instructors Anouk & Carly of Lais, you will carefully prepare and mount real specimens such as insects and scorpions. Each piece is thoughtfully handled and finished on a setting board, allowing you to take home your own beautifully preserved natural specimen as both an artwork and a learning experience.


Butterfly Taxidermy - Friday


Beetle Taxidermy - Saturday


Scorpion Taxidermy - Sunday

subContentHighlight.title: Amsterdam Burlesque
subContentHighlight.content:
Burlesque is a theatrical performance style that blends dance, storytelling, glamour, and playful expression, often creating an atmosphere of elegance and mystery.


At Elfia, experience the captivating artistry of Amsterdam Burlesque, where this unique form of performance takes center stage. Combining glamour, narrative, and refined movement, it offers a distinctive interpretation of fantasy brought to life through atmosphere and emotion. Each performance draws you into a world where enchantment is expressed through silk, shadow, and graceful expression.


Discover a different side of Elfia, where allure meets imagination.

subContentHighlight.title: Cosplay Secrets
subContentHighlight.content:
Meet Alyson Tabbitha Known for her stunning transformations, Alyson brings iconic characters to life with incredible detail, creativity, and performance. From viral content to powerful portrayals, her cosplay is more than just visual, it is storytelling in motion. Meet her at Elfia for photos and an up close experience.


Also joining is Teah (Spill the Tea) Famous for her expressive and magical transformations, Teah blends fantasy and pop culture into captivating characters. Her work inspires fans worldwide to explore creativity and self expression through cosplay.
