highlightImage.title: Compagnia La Giostra Brings Sicilian Fire to Elfia Vorden 2026
highlightImage.content:
After winning over Elfians at Haarzuilens and Arcen with their unforgettable performances, Compagnia La Giostra will make their long-awaited return in 2026, this time lighting up the new festival grounds in Vorden.


Spending nearly twenty years performing around the world, Compagnia La Giostra has carried their Sicilian roots through Algeria, Egypt, Turkey, Portugal, South Africa, Thailand, France, Germany, Finland, Lithuania, Serbia, and Bolivia, gathering cultural influences at every stop. Sicily remains their creative foundation, a historic crossroads of Mediterranean cultures, that continues to guide their artistic approach. This is reflected in their blend of medieval melodies, Sicilian dialect songs, Vulgar Latin verses, and an array of global elements, ranging from New Age and reggae to Celtic and Oriental atmospheres.


Building on this rich musical heritage, Compagnia La Giostra brings together ancient instruments and modern energy in a way that feels both fresh and deeply rooted. The rebec, lyre, mandolin, bagpipe, and traditional flutes blend with electric strings, looping percussion, and lively vocals, creating sets that shift effortlessly between tarantellas, Latin rhythms, nursery rhymes, tongue-twisters, and fast-paced folk pieces. The heartbeat of this vibrant sound comes from the three core members of the group: Michele Conti on rebec, lyre, mandolin, guitars, and bouzouki; Gianfranco Rafalà on pipes, bagpipes, chalumeau, flutes, and stage performance; and Hilmar Pintaldi Funes on percussion. Their long years of collaboration have honed their synergy, giving every performance colour, movement, and an unmistakable character that resonates strongly with audiences.


At Elfia Vorden 2026, Compagnia La Giostra is set to bring back the vibrant joy that made them such a hit with Elfians in previous years. Their return promises a fusion of medieval tradition and modern creativity, filling the new venue with Sicilian warmth, rhythmic energy, and music that brings people together, a fitting start to the first day of Elfia in Vorden.
highlightImage.description: A Sicilian group that will energize Elfia with vibrant medieval melodies, world-music rhythms, and dance-ready folk fusion.

highlightImage.title: Daridel Awakens the Ancient Spirit at Elfia 2026
highlightImage.content:
For the first time ever, Daridel will bring the ancient pulse of pagan folk to Elfia 2026, introducing Elfians to their powerful blend of tribal rhythms, Celtic influences, and atmospheric storytelling. Based in Northern Italy, the band has performed more than 300 hundred shows across Europe, America, and the Arabian Peninsula, building a strong international following of more than half a million fans across social platforms.


Their performances will draw on a wide range of instruments that merge into a sound both wild and enchanting. The raw power of bagpipes, hurdy-gurdy, and deep drums will set the foundation, creating the pulse that drives their music forward. Layered above this, flutes and harps will add delicate melodies that echo tales of fairies, dwarfs, and the hidden corners of the natural world. Meanwhile, bones, horns, and other ancient-inspired elements will weave through it all to form an atmosphere that feels timeless and instinctive, allowing Elfians to feel connected to the rhythms of old Europe. Daridel’s sound will lead audiences through forgotten landscapes and centuries of myth, capturing the spirit of pagan Europe in both its darkness and its light.


At Elfia Vorden 2026, Daridel’s sound will carry Elfians into forgotten landscapes and centuries of myth, capturing the spirit of pagan Europe in both its darkness and its light. With wild dances, primal chants, and immersive melodies, their performance will honour ancient traditions while reshaping them through modern expression, offering a powerful and atmospheric journey that will definitely be one of the highlights of the festival.
highlightImage.description: Performing at Elfia for the first time, Daridel presents pagan folk woven with ancient tribal Celtic energy throughout.

highlightImage.title: The Frounds Bring Their World of Faerie to Elfia Vorden 2026
highlightImage.content:
The Froud family, masters of fantasy art and creature design, will make a long-awaited return to Elfia. Over the years, their creations have enchanted audiences across books, film, and television. Now, fans can get a glimpse into the magic behind their fantastical worlds at Elfia Vorden 2026.


Brian Froud is widely recognised for defining the look of faerie folklore in contemporary fantasy art. His breakthrough came with the bestselling book Faeries (1978), created with Alan Lee, which remains a cornerstone of the genre. His visionary illustrations led to collaborations with Jim Henson on The Dark Crystal and Labyrinth, where he served as conceptual designer and helped build entire imaginative worlds. He later returned as the primary designer for The Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance (2019), bringing his signature style to a new generation. After many years, Brian will once again step into Elfia, accompanied by his wife, Wendy Froud, whose sculptural and puppetry artistry helped bring their shared fantastical universe to life.


Wendy Froud is celebrated for her masterful doll-making, sculpting, and puppet work which gave physical form to mythical beings. Often called the mother of Yoda for her work on Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (1980), she played a key role in shaping Yoda’s early forms, and later carried that same artistry into crafting the Gelflings of The Dark Crystal and several other Jim Henson projects including The Muppet Show, The Muppet Movie, and Labyrinth, with expressive, lifelike detail. Beyond film she has created art dolls, illustrated books, and contributed models and designs across various fantasy projects. Through her collaborative projects with Brian, she gave life to his fantastical sketches, and together they created a creative world that their son Toby grew up immersed in.


Toby Froud, raised amid puppetry, fairie art and fantasy design, has carried the family legacy in his own direction. Recognised by many as the baby from Labyrinth, he has since built his career as a sculptor, puppeteer, fabricator, and filmmaker. His work has appeared in major fantasy productions, from creating creatures for Laika’s stop-motion films to shaping the world of The Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance (2019) for Netflix, demonstrating how he blends traditional craftsmanship with modern special effects. He also directed his own fantasy short film, Lesson Learned (2014), showing his talent not only as designer but as storyteller. In carrying the family tradition forward, Toby continues to expand their fantastical universe with his own artistry and innovation.


At Elfia Vorden 2026, the Frouds trio will come together to share this multi-generational journey through a special lecture where they explore their creative processes, inspirations, and the stories behind their most iconic works. Elfians will also have the rare chance to meet and get their book signed during the official meet and greet session, creating a unique opportunity to engage with the artists whose imagination has shaped the modern fantasy world.
highlightImage.description: Meet the visionary Froud family who will share their creative worlds through a special lecture and meet and greet.

highlightImage.title: Sowulo Brings Ancient Northen Spirit to Elfia
highlightImage.content:
Sowulo is coming to Elfia soon for the very first time and it's a deeply evocative musical project led by Dutch composer and multi-instrumentalist Faber Horbach. For more than a decade, Sowulo has been creating a singular voice within contemporary pagan and folk music by blending ancient Northern European spirituality with immersive sonic landscapes rooted in myth, ritual, and nature.


Inspired by Anglo-Saxon and Viking-age mysticism, Sowulo's music explores the cycles of life, death, and renewal, with the Sun as a central spiritual symbol. Using historic instruments like the carnyx, nyckelharpa, Celtic harp, shamanic drums, and lyre, Horbach weaves Old English lyrics into compositions that feel timeless and ritualistic.


Since 2012, Sowulo has released albums such as Alvenrad, SOL, MANN, and revisited works like Yule (Revisited), exploring cosmology, rebirth, and ancestral heritage. In 2025, the album NIHT took listeners into the realm of night, transformation, and spiritual awakening.


As Sowulo takes the stage at Elfia, Elfians can expect an evocative and meditative encounter with music that resonates with ancient wisdom while speaking to the spiritual journey of the modern listener.
highlightImage.description: Experience the mystical sounds of Sowulo at Elfia. Ancient Northern traditions meet modern folk music in a ritualistic, immersive journey through myth, nature, and the cycles of life.

highlightImage.title: Reikas Tanz Performs Modern Folk Magic at Elfia Vorden
highlightImage.content:
Reikas Tanz is set to perform at Elfia Vorden, bringing their unique blend of traditional and modern folk music to the festival stage. Known across Europe for appearances at Greenfield Festival (CH), Festival Mediaval (DE), and Beltane Pagan Festival (IT), the band captivates audiences with catchy rhythms, rousing melodies, and storytelling through song.


Their songs explore distance, longing, and shared joy, inviting audiences into a world of living folklore. With their 2026 album 'Auf und Davon', the female-fronted collective reaches airy new heights, carried by Neija's expressive vocals, moving listeners toward a horizon full of musical discovery.


Reikas Tanz blends traditional instruments like the hurdy-gurdy, nyckelharpa, and Irish bouzouki with accordion, double bass, and guitar, creating stirring, danceable contemporary folk that honours tradition while bringing it into the present.


At Elfia Vorden, Elfians can expect an immersive, energetic performance, where the rhythm, melody, and storytelling combine to bring folklore to life on stage.
highlightImage.description: Join Reikas Tanz at Elfia Vorden for modern folk magic, a captivating blend of hurdy-gurdy, nyckelharpa, guitar, and danceable, living folklore.

highlightImage.title: 3 Daft Monkeys Bring Their Wild Fold-World Fusion To Elfia Vorden
highlightImage.content:
Hailing from Cornwall's rugged coast, 3 Daft Monkeys have carved out a unique place in the world folk scene with their bold, genre-defying sound that's as joyous as it is unpredictable. Formed in 2000, this independent band blends Cornish and Celtic folk roots with Balkan, Romani, Latin, punk, reggae, dub, and dance rhythms, creating music that's difficult to pigeonhole but impossible to ignore.


At the heart of the band are Tim Ashton (vocals, 12-string guitar, whistle), Athene Roberts (fiddle, vocals), Rich Mulryne (percussion), and Jamie Graham (bass). Together, they weave electrifying fiddle lines, pulse-racing grooves, and infectious rhythms that make audiences want to move. Whether in a packed festival field or an intimate venue.


3 Daft Monkeys' music reflects the spirit of global folk: lively storytelling, theatrical energy, and moments that range from foot-stomping reels to cinematic peaks. They've earned acclaim across the UK and Europe, including being highlighted as one of the \\\"Highlights of Glastonbury\\\" by BBC broadcaster Mark Radcliffe, and have performed on BBC Radio 2 sessions.


Their high-energy live shows are known for their warmth, wit, and an irresistible invitation to dance. At Elfia Vorden, expect a heady mix of celebration and catharsis, an experience that's as joyful and unpredictable as the band itself!
highlightImage.description: 3 Daft Monkeys, praised by BBC Radio 2, bring wild Cornish folk, Balkan rhythms, electrifying fiddles, and dance-ready grooves to Elfia Vorden.

highlightImage.title: The Trouble Notes Bring Borderless World-Folk Energy to Elfia Vorden
highlightImage.content:
Ready for a musical journey that crosses borders?


With The Trouble Notes, you're stepping into a world of explosive energy, worldly melodies, and constant surprises. This progressive world-folk trio has been turning heads since 2013, blending sounds and stories from across the globe into a live show that's as unpredictable as it is exhilarating.


Their music is shaped by movement across countries, cultures, and stages worldwide. With roots spanning three continents, The Trouble Notes channel that diversity into fast-paced rhythms, soaring violin lines, and driving guitar and percussion that pull you straight into the moment.


A Trouble Notes performance is never just what you expect. Guest musicians often appear on stage, adding new colours and influences to an already vibrant sound. From major festival stages across Europe to tours throughout Europe and North America, and television appearances in the USA, Europe, Japan, and Brazil, this is a band built for live audiences.


They've shared stages with international legends like Jethro Tull, Rodrigo y Gabriela, and America, and their album "Liberty Awaits" was praised as "a transcendent exploration and fusion of various folk styles." As BBC Radio's Faye Hatcher put it: this is music that takes you on a journey — one that makes you clap, tap your feet, and maybe even dance without realising it.


When The Trouble Notes arrive at Elfia, come ready to travel, no passport required!
highlightImage.description: The Trouble Notes deliver exhilarating world folk fusion, combining violin, acoustic guitar, and percussion into an energetic, globe-trotting performance that transcends borders.

highlightImage.title: Deloraine Brings Czech Folk Fantasy to Elfia Vorden
highlightImage.content:
Deloraine is a pagan fantasy folk band from the Czech Republic, known for high-energy live performances filled with ritualistic elements, pagan dances, and striking costumes. Their music blends powerful vocals with a wide range of ethnic and exotic instruments, creating an immersive and mystical atmosphere that pulls audiences into another world.


Inspired by fantasy literature, The Witcher universe, and ancient Celtic, Slavic, and Nordic myths, Deloraine tells stories rooted in old legends and pagan traditions. Their songs feel like scenes from unwritten sagas, where magic, folklore, and raw emotion meet.


The band has released two acclaimed albums, "Vlaštovka" (Swallow Bird) and "Srdce z kamene" (The Heart of Stone), both named Album of the Week by musicserver.cz. Their single "Sabat" won CeltCast awards for Best Song and Best Music Video of 2023, and they have also created official music videos for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt.


Deloraine has performed at major international festivals such as Wave Gotik Treffen, Cernunnos Fest, and Trolls & Légendes, and shared the stage with artists including Faun, Eivør, Percival, and Korpiklaani.

From open-air festivals to packed clubs and metal gigs, Deloraine delivers tireless, powerful performances where music is both ritual and mission — and at Elfia Vorden, that ritual will unfold live before your eyes.
highlightImage.description: Let's welcome Deloraine! They weave tales of myth and magic with powerful vocals and traditional instruments, Deloraine presents their distinctive fusion of folk, fantasy, and medieval music.

highlightImage.title: Good Habits Bring Cinematic Folk and Joyful Energy to Elfia Vorden
highlightImage.content:
Good Habits bring a burst of optimism to every stage. Fronted by singer-cellist Bonnie Schwarz, with Pete Shaw on accordion and synths and Jen Walinetski on drums, their music weaves cinematic soundscapes, folk storytelling, and groove-driven rhythms into a show that's impossible to sit still through.


Born from an unexpected adventure in New Zealand during the pandemic, their songs celebrate connection, resilience, and creativity. Every performance is a shared experience — playful, heartfelt, and full of joy. You'll find yourself clapping, swaying, and laughing along as Good Habits fill the space with music that feels alive and inclusive.


From Glastonbury to WOMAD, Cambridge to Green Man, and with BBC Radio support and a UK Top 40 Folk album under their belt, Good Habits have already travelled far — but at Elfia, they're ready to bring their infectious energy straight to you.


Get ready to dance, sing, and feel every note. Good Habits are here, and they're impossible to resist.
highlightImage.description: Get ready to move it with Good Habits. This New Zealand band blends Celtic folk, punk energy, and festival-ready rhythms into a live show that's fast, fun, and impossible to stand still for.

highlightImage.title: Merulsa Brings Enchanting Folk to Elfia Vorden
highlightImage.content:
Merulsa is a captivating folk band that draws listeners into a world where emotion takes center stage. With warm and soulful vocals that feel both ancient and personal. Merel Bakker, the voice behind Merulsa, is steadily making her mark in the folk scene. In 2025, she is releasing her first full album and collaborating with artists such as Oliver Satyr. She's no stranger to recording, having released several singles and an EP at the age of fourteen, Merel brings both experience and fresh creativity to every performance.


On her journey to the Kingdom of Elfia, Merel returns once again, accompanied by her musical knights; Femke (flute), Jan (piano), Tycho (bass), and Hans (drums), bringing each song to life with enchantment, depth, and magic.
highlightImage.description: Merulsa invites you to step into that hush before the spell is spoken, where music lingers like stardust and every melody feels like a path waiting to be followed.

highlightImage.title: Sunfire
highlightImage.content:
Sunfire storms the stage with music that stays with you long after the final note fades. Their music is bold and unrelenting, woven from heartfelt vocals, vibrant strings, and powerful rhythms. In their music lives a quiet power; voices rising together as one beneath an open sky.


Leading the charge is Satria Karsono (lead vocals, guitar & banjo), joined by Sophie Zaaijer (violin & vocals), whose soaring lines cut through the air like light through mist. Berend de Vries (electric guitar & vocals) brings grit and power with bold, resonant riffs, while Michel Beeckman (bass & vocals) and Jeroen van Leeuwen (drums, percussion & vocals) drive the heartbeat of the band, anchoring each performance with grounded rhythm and unwavering energy.


Their appearance at the Kingdom of Elfia adds another chapter to the realm's unfolding tale, where music and celebration meet to create a night worthy of the festival's magic
highlightImage.description: Sunfire returns to ignite the evening with bold melodies and untamed energy. Strings blaze like sparks in the dark, rhythms roll like distant thunder, and the air hums with anticipation.

highlightImage.title: Teatro Pavana Brings a Living Spectacle to Eflia Vorden
highlightImage.content: Step into a Kingdom where fantasy is no longer confined to the stage. Teatro Pavana brings a living spectacle to Elfia Vorden 2026, where creatures of legend roam freely among the castle grounds. Picture hippos wandering past ancient walls, giraffes gliding gracefully through enchanted crowds, and papagali bursting into brilliant, dazzling colors at every turn. Each moment is crafted to surprise, delight, and transport you into a world where magic feels real. This isn't just a performance, it's an experience where the extraordinary meets the everyday, creating memories that will stay with you long after the festival ends. Explore, wonder, and let yourself be swept away in a truly immersive fairytale brought to life by Teatro Pavana.
highlightImage.description: Fantasy leaps off the stage with Teatro Pavana, where hippos wander through historic walls, giraffes roam the festival, and papagali shine in a spectacular display of color, making the Kingdom of Elfia truly unforgettable.

highlightImage.title: The Lonesome Malones
highlightImage.content:
Their music carries the spirit of wandering storytellers and festival nights, where quick-fingered melodies leap from guitar, mandolin, banjo, and bass, weaving together a sound that is both joyful and timeless. With every note, they invite travelers of the realm to pause their journey, gather close, and share in the music.


At the heart of the band stands Steven Verrips on guitar, joined by Jasper Schalks on mandolin, Satria B. Karsono on banjo, and Fadzli Zahari on bass. Together, they create a lively performance full of rhythm, charm, and the unmistakable spirit of a good festival gathering.


Their appearance at the Kingdom of Elfia adds another melody to the festival's ever-growing tale, where music echoes through the grounds and every path may lead to a new song.
highlightImage.description: From distant roads and lively taverns, The Lonesome Malones arrive at the Kingdom of Elfia with bright strings, warm harmonies, and rhythms that seem made for dancing beneath the open sky.

highlightImage.title: Perkelt

From the hidden corners of a modern mystical underworld, Perkelt brings a sound unlike anything you've experienced before. Blending early medieval influences with Celtic melodies and lightning-fast rhythms, the band has created their own unique style: pagan speed folk.


With hypnotic chants, soaring fiddle lines, rapid-fire recorder, tribal didgeridoo, and powerful percussion, Perkelt delivers a spellbinding musical journey filled with energy, storytelling, and raw emotion.


Having captivated audiences across Europe, Perkelt now brings their free-spirited and otherworldly performance to Elfia.
highlightImage.description: From the hidden corners of a modern-day mystical underworld, Perkelt brings a sound unlike anything you've ever heard.

highlightImage.title: Luneris
highlightImage.content:
Behind Luneris are two sisters; Héloïse, a harpist, and Mathilde, a violinist, who are redefining electronic music by blending it with Celtic and Nordic traditions. Their live performances fuse electric harp, violin, and traditional instruments like the flute, jaw harp, and olifant with hypnotic electronic production, creating an immersive soundscape that is both organic and futuristic.


Each show is a captivating journey into a mystical world, where music, lights, and audience interaction merge to create a shared trance-like experience. From intimate venues to festivals across Europe, Luneris invites audiences to dance, feel, and lose themselves in a sound that bridges ancient melodies with modern electronic pulses. Their upcoming 2026 album promises to continue this sonic quest, celebrating trance as a universal language that connects past and present.


Héloïse and Mathilde bring technical mastery, creativity, and a deep understanding of tradition to every performance. Their body of work spans productions for young audiences, classical projects, and innovative shows like Electro Pagan Trance, proving that their music is not only heard, it is truly experienced.

Meet her at Elfia and see your favorite characters come to life in person. Don't miss the chance to connect, take photos, and witness Alyson's incredible talent up close!

As your journey unfolds, live music and storytelling intertwine, creating an immersive experience where every choice shapes your path. Forge your party, face the unknown, and become part of a story that evolves in real time, from quiet intrigue to heroic triumphs.


Will you rise as heroes… or fall to the unknown?

highlightImage.title: Amsterdam Burlesque
highlightImage.content:
Experience the captivating artistry of Amsterdam Burlesque at Elfia, where elegance and mystery take center stage.


Blending glamour, storytelling, and refined performance, Amsterdam Burlesque offers a unique interpretation of fantasy, one that unfolds through movement, atmosphere, and emotion. Each moment invites you into a world where enchantment shimmers in silk and shadow.


Discover a different side of Elfia, where allure meets imagination.

highlightImage.title: Spill The Tea
highlightImage.content:

Renowned for her striking transformations and expressive performances, she has captivated audiences worldwide through cosplay that blends craftsmanship, storytelling, and immersive character portrayal. From fantasy legends to iconic pop culture figures, each creation is brought to life with precision, personality, and a strong sense of narrative magic.


Beyond her visual presence, she continues to inspire a global creative community by encouraging self-expression and artistic exploration through cosplay and performance. Her work highlights the power of transformation as both an art form and a storytelling medium.

Don't forget to get your tickets to meet Spill The Tea!
highlightImage.description: A celebrated cosplay creator known for transformative character work, Spill The Tea joins Elfia this May, bringing fantasy, performance, and creativity to life within the Kingdom.

highlightImage.title: The Royal Seahorseriders
highlightImage.content:
The Royal Seahorseriders joins Elfia as a steampunk collective presenting a carefully crafted world where imagination, design, and storytelling come together in a shared immersive experience.


Their presence at the festival is centred around a detailed camp environment that reflects the artistry and creativity of steampunk culture, offering visitors an opportunity to explore a thoughtfully built setting inspired by mechanical fantasy and narrative design.


Guests will encounter a selection of handcrafted works and interactive elements, including steampunk-inspired vehicles, costume design, and curated objects that each reflect their own story and character.
highlightImage.description: A vibrant steampunk collective, The Royal Seahorseriders bring an immersive, interactive camp to Elfia filled with creativity, craftsmanship, and family-friendly adventures.

highlightImage.title: Chelseaboy
highlightImage.content:
ChelseaBoy brings a unique fusion of fashion, fantasy, and performance to Elfia this May.


Known for pushing creative boundaries, ChelseaBoy transforms each appearance into a striking visual experience. Every look is crafted with precision, imagination, and a fearless approach to identity, resulting in performances that captivate and inspire.


Blending artistry with individuality, their work goes beyond spectacle, inviting audiences into a world where self-expression takes center stage and creativity knows no limits.


Experience ChelseaBoy's artistry up close during special appearances at Elfia, and discover a bold new dimension of fantasy within the Kingdom.
highlightImage.description: Bold, visionary, and impossible to ignore... ChelseaBoy takes the stage like never before.

highlightImage.title: De Paardentovenaar
highlightImage.content:
Before the gates of Elfia open, a little magic is already at work in the parking area.


De Paardentovenaar welcomes our noble horses with calm hands, gentle care, and a touch of enchantment. After their journey, they can enjoy soothing horse massages designed to help them relax, unwind, and arrive in comfort.


It's a moment of rest, care, and connection before the adventure truly begins. Because even the strongest horses deserve to be treated like royalty.


Welcome to Elfia, where magic begins before you even enter the realm.
highlightImage.description: A magical welcome awaits your horses at Elfia with care, calm, and a touch of enchantment before the journey begins.

highlightImage.title: Living Statues
highlightImage.content:
Silent... still... and suddenly alive.


Throughout Elfia, our Living Sculptures will be present across the realm, blending seamlessly into their surroundings before revealing themselves in the most unexpected and enchanting ways.


Carefully crafted and brought to life through subtle movement and expression, these performers transform stillness into art. Each encounter is designed to create a moment of surprise, wonder, and quiet magic within the festival grounds.


Will you notice them before they move... or will they catch you completely off guard?


You can find the Living Sculptures appearing on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday across the festival grounds, waiting to be discovered as part of your journey through Elfia.
highlightImage.description: Silent, still, and suddenly alive. Throughout Elfia, our Living Sculptures will be present across the realm, blending seamlessly into their surroundings before revealing themselves in the most unexpected and enchanting ways.

highlightImage.title: De Lekke Ton
highlightImage.content:
Before the festival even begins, De Lekke Ton is already changing the world around them…


Their clever ship arrives like a story unfolding on the water, sails filled with laughter, music, and a hint of mystery. The crew steps ashore with bold energy, turning the harbour into a playground of pirate fantasy.

Drums echo, songs rise, and the air feels alive with adventure. As day fades into night, firelight dances with shadows, stories are shared, and the whole place transforms into a living pirate realm where everyone becomes part of the legend.


Join the voyage and experience the chaos, meet De Lekke Ton live at Elfia.
highlightImage.description: A magical pirate welcome arrives with De Lekke Ton, where the seas bring adventure and every moment feels like the start of a living legend.

highlightImage.title: Erik the Viking
highlightImage.content:
Erik the Viking is a professional performance group known for their thrilling fire artistry, combining fire eating, fire poi, pyrotechnics, juggling, and stilt walking into one unforgettable spectacle.


With experience performing both nationally and internationally, they bring high-energy entertainment wherever they go.


This delightfully eccentric family of pyro performers blends skill, humour, and spectacle, creating a show that captivates audiences of all ages.
highlightImage.description: Erik the Viking brings a spectacular fire show with fire eating, fire breathing, pyrotechnics, and daring stilt walking for all ages.

highlightImage.title: Dansensemble Phoenix
highlightImage.content:
For the third year in a row, Dansensemble Phoenix returns to Elfia, bringing their signature energy, passion for folklore, and vibrant stage presence.


This young and enthusiastic dance ensemble celebrates traditional dances from cultures all around the world, using folklore as a shared language that connects communities beyond borders. Each performance is danced to authentic traditional music, creating a rich atmosphere filled with rhythm, colour, and cultural expression.


This year, Phoenix is excited to present a brand-new repertoire featuring dances from Greece, Mallorca, Italy, Georgia, and Albania, offering visitors a journey through diverse traditions and styles.


With lively footwork and contagious enthusiasm, Dansensemble Phoenix invites you to experience how folklore beautifully unites the world, live at Elfia Vorden 2026.
highlightImage.description: Dansensemble Phoenix returns to Elfia with energetic folklore performances and a new repertoire from Greece, Italy, Georgia, and more.

highlightImage.title: Paloina
highlightImage.content: Travel the world through dance, music, and culture with Paloina. A powerful live orchestra and 25 dancers bring folklore to life like never before. Paloina is an international dance ensemble featuring around 25 young dancers, brought to life with a powerful live orchestra. Dressed in authentic costumes, they take you on a journey through cultures, rhythms, and traditions from around the world. Rooted in respect for cultural diversity, Paloina transforms folklore into a living, breathing experience that connects with today's audience. This is more than a performance—it’s a celebration of culture in motion. Don't miss it at Vorden 2026
highlightImage.description: Travel the world through dance, music, and culture with Paloina—a powerful live orchestra and around 25 dancers bringing folklore to life.

highlightImage.title: Hai la Joc
highlightImage.content:
A journey across continents through dance, from Groningen to the world stage with Hai la joc.


Hai la joc is a folklore dance group from Groningen, bringing cultures to life through movement and music.


From Argentina and Mexico to South Africa, Georgia, Turkey, and beyond, their performances celebrate traditions from around the world.


They also proudly perform Dutch dances, sharing their heritage at festivals across different countries.


Experience a vibrant mix of cultures, stories, and rhythms in every step.
highlightImage.description: A folklore dance group from Groningen bringing cultures to life through movement and music—from Argentina and Mexico to South Africa, Georgia, Turkey, and beyond.

highlightImage.title: Horse by Any Dale
highlightImage.content:
Step into the wild western spirit at Elfia and experience a moment of calm among horses and riders.


Take your time here among the horses and their riders, where the steady rhythm of hooves and the quiet presence of these gentle animals create a peaceful prairie atmosphere.


Whether you are a wanderer passing through or a curious visitor eager to explore, you will always find a welcoming place beside the fence line. The cowboys of Any Dale Hippique are ready to greet you and share their passion, offering a glimpse into their unique corner of Elfia.


Step forward, take in the surroundings, capture memorable photos, and enjoy meaningful conversations while embracing the spirit of the wild west.
highlightImage.description: Step into the wild western spirit at Elfia—calm among horses and riders, with the cowboys of Any Dale Hippique ready to greet you beside the fence line.

highlightImage.title: TriOblique
highlightImage.content:
From Genoa to the world, TriOblique brings a wild mix of Irish tradition and modern grooves that will make you move without even thinking about it.


TriOblique is formed by Aurélien Congrega (Irish bouzouki, lead vocals), Susanna Roncallo (guitar, vocals), and Dario Gisotti (Uillean pipes, whistles, accordion, vocals).


Their sound keeps the soul of traditional music while mixing in rock, funk, dance rhythms, and fast fingerpicking that keeps you hooked from start to finish. Their album “Danse avec les renards” has already traveled across Europe, turning stages into dance floors and audiences into smiling, moving crowds.


TriOblique is all about music that surprises you and makes it impossible to stay still.
highlightImage.description: From Genoa to the world, TriOblique blends Irish tradition with modern grooves into an irresistible, high-energy balfolk experience.

highlightImage.title: Viadeyra
highlightImage.content:
A balfolk journey through ancient melodies, where dance, history, and culture move as one.


Viadeyra brings together musicians from Italy and France, united by a love for European balfolk and early music traditions.


Their music travels through time, blending troubadour songs, Sephardic melodies, medieval Italian pieces, and influences from across Europe and beyond. In the dance, everything connects.


History becomes rhythm, and rhythm becomes movement.


Viadeyra performs across Europe.
highlightImage.description: A balfolk journey through ancient melodies where dance, history, and culture move as one across time and tradition.

highlightImage.title: Le Driadi
highlightImage.content:
Neo-trad balfolk, indie energy, and dance rhythms that will keep your feet moving all night long.


Le Driadi blends neo-trad balfolk, Italian songwriting, and contemporary indie energy into a sound that feels both timeless and fresh.


From dreamy mazurkas to fast-paced scottishes and powerful Breton chains, their concerts turn every dance floor into a living adventure. Born from late-night jam sessions and festivals across Europe, they bring infectious grooves, warm energy, and music that pulls you straight into the moment.


Step into their sonic forest and lose yourself in the magic.
highlightImage.description: Neo-trad balfolk meets indie energy in a warm, rhythm-driven live set that keeps the dance floor moving all night.
